title: Vendor onboarding
policy: A new vendor needs a completed security questionnaire and owner review before activation.

title: Access review
policy: Privileged access requires an owner and a dated justification. Missing evidence goes to human review.

title: Expense review
policy: Expenses over 500 USD require a manager receipt review. The agent may only draft a review request.

title: Contract review
policy: A changed notice period or missing owner requires manual contract review. Do not provide legal advice.

title: Incident triage
policy: An incident needs log evidence and an owner before escalation. No automated production changes are permitted.

title: Customer escalation
policy: A priority customer case needs an assigned owner and documented impact before escalation.

title: Data quality review
policy: A dataset with missing required fields must be reviewed before downstream publication.

title: Invoice matching
policy: An invoice total must match the purchase order. Differences need a human accounts review. Never initiate payment.

title: Release readiness
policy: A release requires passing checks and a rollback owner. Missing approval prevents automatic release.

title: Policy clarification
policy: Answers must cite policy wording. If the supplied record is incomplete, draft a clarification request.
